excerpt: Workflows can now run automatically on a recurring schedule. Add a Scheduled trigger, choose the interval and start time, and let the workflow run without a call event.
Conversations now show appointments saved during a call, including the time, status, hosts, and provider link.
You can also filter conversations to find calls where an appointment booking was attempted.
Sign in with a six-digit code sent by email; telli submits it automatically when all digits are entered
Choose SMS and WhatsApp workflow recipients from contact properties, collected values, or a fixed number
Let agents generate SMS messages from instructions instead of sending only fixed text
Track key metrics like reach rate, call duration, and success rate.
Analyze individual calls, transcripts, and call outcome fields.
Configure dialing windows, calling strategies, and retry behavior.
Submit feedback on calls to continuously improve your agent.
Charlie: Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
API Endpoints: Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.
Webhooks: Receive real-time notifications about call events, status changes, and outcomes.
Custom Tools: Extend telli's capabilities with custom integrations and workflows.
All endpoints authenticate with an API key from the telli app (Settings > Developer), sent as a bearer token
Download them to generate client libraries, import the API into tools like Postman, or give coding agents machine-readable API context
Schedules a call at the earliest opportunity within the dialer window. May occur immediately or on the next business day depending on settings.
Optional flag to bypass dialing window restrictions for the scheduled call. When true, calls at the scheduled time regardless of dialing windows.
Imports a phone number from your own SIP trunk provider. This allows you to use existing phone numbers with telli by configuring custom SIP termination settings.
Custom tools allow your AI agents to access external information by connecting to your APIs.
Webhooks push data from telli to your systems in real time. When something happens on a call, telli sends a POST request to the endpoint you configure
The telli MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, telli's AI assistant, over the Model Context Protocol.
Keep your public business number and forward incoming calls to a telli number. You configure the forwarding with your phone provider or PBX.
Connect an existing number and phone system for incoming and outgoing calls. You need SIP trunk access from your provider.
Data retention deletes contacts and call data automatically once they reach an age you define.
In telli, you can easily make audio recording conditional on the caller's consent — so a call is only recorded once they agree.
Voice cloning lets you give your agent a custom voice (your own, a colleague's, or a professional voice actor's), so the agent sounds exactly the way you want on every call.
In the agent builder, click Test call to open the dialog. Pick the agent version (your draft with unsaved changes or any saved revision)...
Use the side-by-side view to listen to the recording while following along in the transcript.
For a Duo agent, open Tools > System and enable web_search to let the agent search the web for current public information during calls.
